name: riwaq-production-system
description: Riwaq Production System — data-driven video template (one engine, many identities)

scripts.render:golden: npm run props:golden && remotion render src/index.ts Episode exports/MASTER_WEB_GOLDEN_001.mp4 --props=data/projects/GOLDEN_001/render_props.json --concurrency=1 --crf=18
scripts.render:golden:draft: npm run props:golden && remotion render src/index.ts Episode exports/_DRAFT_GOLDEN_001.mp4 --props=data/projects/GOLDEN_001/render_props.json --concurrency=1 --scale=0.5
scripts.still: npm run props:golden && remotion still src/index.ts Episode exports/STILL_GOLDEN_001.png --props=data/projects/GOLDEN_001/render_props.json --frame=45
